basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Mandi Catalyst (IIT Mandi Catalyst) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by Indian Institute of Technology Mandi Catalyst (IIT Mandi Catalyst) on its official website for the recruitment of 1 Manager/Senior Manager/AGM/GM (Portfolio Management) post. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for experienced professionals looking to work in the startup incubation and innovation ecosystem.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Mandi Catalyst Manager/Senior Manager/AGM/GM (Portfolio Management) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-07-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Mandi Catalyst to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-07-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Mandi Catalyst to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Mandi Catalyst recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Manager/Senior Manager/AGM/GM (Portfolio Management) posts is 31st July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Business Administration, Entrepreneurship, Engineering, or a related field.

faq.question: Q3. Is prior experience mandatory for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, prior experience in incubation centres, accelerators, startup ecosystem organisations, or innovation programs is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official IIT Mandi Catalyst website on or before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Manager/Senior Manager/AGM/GM (Portfolio Management) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will include a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary will be offered as per industry norms and the candidate's experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Mandi Catalyst located?
faq.answer: IIT Mandi Catalyst is located in Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, with the pincode 175005.

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available for the Manager/Senior Manager/AGM/GM (Portfolio Management) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Manager/Senior Manager/AGM/GM (Portfolio Management) post.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications must be submitted online only. Offline applications will not be accepted.
